name: voice-input
title: VoiceInput
description: Push-to-talk that transcribes on device: the mic is the variant's key, a waveform drawn in the variant, then the transcript with Use and Retry.

files.content:
export { VoiceInput, voiceInputLabels, type VoiceActionsProps, type VoiceInputIcons, type VoiceInputLabels, type VoiceInputProps, type VoiceInputStyles, type VoiceMicProps } from './voice-input'
export { useVoiceInput, simulatedRecorder, speechLevel, type Recorder, type SimulatedRecorderOptions, type UseVoiceInputOptions, type VoiceInputState, type VoiceInputStatus } from './use-voice-input'

docs: Audio capture is not bundled: pass `recorder` (expo-audio, react-native-audio-record or your own module) with `start()`, `stop()` → WAV/PCM bytes and `onLevel()`. Without one a simulated recorder runs, so the mock and the playground just work.

limits: Runs on iPhone with Apple SpeechAnalyzer. The app passes in the recorder (for example expo-audio).
